reviews.comment: Not a good professor. Was rude and never followed up on their words. Avoid this professor unless you have to take them. Then just do your best and move on to the next class

Good lecturer but just very hard professor and grader. His policies suck and I find myself to get screwed over and over in his class when I put in the work. He also refers to the textbook a lot so use that as a test problem guide.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Amarnath is not a very helpful professor. Class was made unnecessarily difficult but if you go to talk to him he can be easier to work with. I would recommend other professors if you get the chance.
Hes very knowledgeable and will help you understand and solve problems

The course requires to do a lot of homework, and you will have a stressful semester. He is strict with the grade thresholds, and the exams might be too tough. So, be careful before taking this course.

The course requires you to do so many tasks such as reading papers, and books. The exams are tough, and you might see that the average of the class goes around 50%, while the instructor does not curve the grades. If you need to take this course, expect to be busy for more than 10 hrs per week, and study hard for five exams in a semester.

He is totally unfair in grading, and the slides are so boring. He is teaching so many things, more than enough. The exams are too tough and he is asking you to solve questions that you had no idea about. He is taking a quiz each week, and assign a lab assignment on a weekly basis. The class environment is not friendly and it is full of stress.

Pros: - Great lecturer. Truly enjoys the material he teaches. - Accent, but fairly easy to understand. - Lecture videos and slides were helpful for class exams. - Homework and labs were self-explanatory. Cons: - Lab exams were VERY difficult. VERY time limited. Be VERY prepared. Little room for error. Besides, lab exams, great class overall.

Get's very angry if you're late to class, lectures are insanely long, 50 page power point slides per class. Tries to cram information in that is not tested on. Is big on cheating and loves to use academic dishonesty on students. Makes your really work for the grade with so much info.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pop quizzes occur often & are very few questions. He doesn't ever really call people out for using lecture time to work on stuff for other classes or using Facebook/ their phones, which is nice because lecture can be dull. Does get really upset when people are late. Tests are fairly easy, made up of old quizzes and HWs. Quizlet is helpful to study.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I didn't think it was possible to have a class that was this boring. You'll do fine if you pay attention. But, he isn't good at lecturing. The entire class is basically lectures, paperwork, and spreadsheet math. Its not a particularly hard class, but the averages stayed pretty low on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY
